visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with vibrant green hair and a light purple off-the-shoulder top uses a black circular makeup puff with a gold YSL logo to dab her right cheek. Her facial expression is one of exaggerated surprise as she looks into a mirror off-camera. The lighting is bright, high-key studio lighting, highlighting her smooth skin. (2) The scene transitions to the woman talking directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands. Graphical logos for Dcard and Threads appear as overlays on the left and right. She continues dabbing her face with the black puff, demonstrating the application technique. (3) A close-up shot shows the woman applying the makeup puff to a bruise on her leg to demonstrate coverage. The skin texture is clearly visible under bright light. She then shows the back of her hand, applying the product over visible veins. (4) The camera focuses on the product itself: a pale pink, quilted leather makeup cushion with a gold YSL logo. The woman opens the cushion, revealing the mirror and the makeup-saturated sponge inside. The background is a white marble surface. (5) A split-screen comparison appears, showing the woman's face with and without the product. Text overlays point out 'pores' and 'dark circles.' The side with the product appears significantly more radiant and even-toned. (6) The woman is shown in a different setting, appearing to be on a treadmill or in a gym. She is sweating visibly, with droplets on her chest and forehead. She holds up a smartphone showing a timer and a pedometer app to prove she has been exercising. She points to her face to show the makeup is still intact despite the sweat.

The background music is an upbeat, driving electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 beat. A sharp 'ding' sound effect accompanies the appearance of text on screen. (2) As the narrator discusses social media buzz, digital 'pop' sound effects play in quick succession. Her voice has a bright, rising intonation, conveying excitement. The BGM maintains a consistent intensity. (3) A subtle 'whoosh' transition sound leads into a more descriptive section where the voice quality becomes professional and clear, explaining product features. Rhythmic electronic pulses in the BGM sync with the narrator's delivery. (4) The audio texture shifts slightly as the sound of a treadmill motor and rhythmic footsteps are audible in the background. The narrator's voice remains energetic but exhibits slight breathiness as she discusses the 'Summer Test.' (5) The video concludes with a final energetic vocal peak from the narrator, followed by a quick musical fade-out with a sparkling digital chime.
